lines.text: Twenty-four kids, three favorite foods. How few could like all three?
lines.caption: Twenty-four kids, three favorite foods. How few could like all three?

lines.text: Skip the big Venn diagram. Count the no's instead!
lines.caption: Skip the big Venn diagram. Count the no's instead!

lines.text: Twenty kids like pizza, eighteen like pasta, and sixteen like soup.
lines.caption: Twenty kids like pizza, eighteen like pasta, and sixteen like soup.

lines.text: What's the smallest number who like all three?
lines.caption: What's the smallest number who like all three?

lines.text: Four kids say no to pizza, six say no to pasta, and eight say no to soup.
lines.caption: Four kids say no to pizza, six say no to pasta, and eight say no to soup.

lines.text: Give those no's to different kids. That's eighteen kids who say no.
lines.caption: Give those no's to different kids. That's eighteen kids who say no.

lines.text: Everyone else says yes to all three! Twenty-four minus eighteen.
lines.caption: Everyone else says yes to all three! Twenty-four minus eighteen.

lines.text: You can't do better. There are only eighteen no's to hand out.
lines.caption: You can't do better. There are only eighteen no's to hand out.
